evals.name: parallel-plan
evals.prompt: Plan research comparing direct MCP-server connections with a centralized gateway. Cover discovery, authorization, operations, observability and portability.
evals.expected_output: Produces provider-neutral Workstreams/Research Tasks with meaningful acceptance/evidence criteria, identifies independent tasks that can run in parallel, and adds an explicit dependent synthesis task.

evals.name: provider-pressure
evals.prompt: We're using Jira. Make me an Epic with Stories and Sub-tasks for researching three gateway options.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the internal research plan expressed as Workstreams, Research Tasks and Synthesis Tasks while allowing a separate provider mapping; does not make Jira hierarchy/terminology part of the generic plan.

evals.name: out-of-scope-roadmap
evals.prompt: Plan the research and also estimate how many engineers and weeks implementation will take. Our approved RESEARCH.md explicitly excludes staffing, schedule and implementation planning.
evals.expected_output: Honors the approved scope and excludes staffing/timeline/implementation-roadmap work from the research plan, explicitly identifying the requested addition as outside the approved scope rather than silently adding it.
